question:
Simplify.

17 × 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4]
solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8081cb6e2e9e278f0c5fc562dac27ef17f224dea87eefe9e8c2ff8e4b8ac4dbd.png] 

**Given:**

17 × 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4]

**Calculation:**

17 × 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4]

⇒136 - 6 + [24 ÷ 6 - 4]

⇒130 + [4 - 4]

⇒ 130 + 0

⇒ 130 

**∴ The required result = 130**
